name: scratch-trap-crossing
_notes: Scratch: the trap tiles as a *route* rather than a demo. The only way to the flag is the bridge — columns 14-22 and 25-33 are cracked (`d`) over a 20-tile pit whose floor (row 15) is spikes, and the two columns between them (23, 24) are missing, so the crossing is a commitment: keep moving, take the gap in the middle on the fly, and let the deck fall in behind you. A body that hesitates anywhere on the span loses the tile under its feet and lands on the spikes; there is no second route and no pad. Three spikes on the far ground (columns 38-40) are the crossing's last test. `reach` reads the bridge as ground, so the level is beatable in principle and unbeatable without the crossing. For the learning measurement in FINDINGS.md.
